title: Hydration equilibrium-controlled cation–anion coordination competition for precise recovery of all valuable metals from spent lithium-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05276A, Paper
Mingqiang Cheng, Juanjian Ru, Shukai Miao, Yixin Hua, Qibo Zhang, Cunying Xu, Zhipeng Zhou, Ding Wang, Wenchao Zhang, Jiexi Wang, Zaiping Guo
The valuable metals in spent LIBs can be precisely separated by controlling the temperature and H2O content in deep eutectic solvents.
